candidate.answerReason: An equilateral triangle on BC creates isosceles triangles with base angles 85° and 35°. Their angles at the new vertex establish collinearity with A and D, giving angle BAD = 85°.

methods.label: Build an equilateral triangle
methods.explanation:
The remaining two interior angles of the quadrilateral sum to \(360^\circ-70^\circ-170^\circ=120^\circ\), so neither is reflex and the quadrilateral is convex. The three equal consecutive sides suggest constructing an equilateral triangle: its equal sides will create two isosceles triangles.

Construct equilateral triangle \(BCE\) on the same side of \(BC\) as \(A\). Its angles are \(60^\circ\), so
\[
\angle ABE=70^\circ-60^\circ=10^\circ.
\]
Because \(AB=BC=BE\), triangle \(ABE\) is isosceles. Hence
\[
\angle BAE=\angle AEB
=\frac{180^\circ-10^\circ}{2}=85^\circ.
\]
At \(C\), the ray \(CE\) lies inside \(\angle BCD\), giving
\[
\angle ECD=170^\circ-60^\circ=110^\circ.
\]
Also, \(CE=BC=CD\), so triangle \(CED\) is isosceles and
\[
\angle CED=\frac{180^\circ-110^\circ}{2}=35^\circ.
\]
Since \(BE\) lies inside \(\angle ABC\), points \(A\) and \(C\) lie on opposite sides of \(BE\). Similarly, \(B\) and \(D\) lie on opposite sides of \(CE\). Thus the angles \(AEB\), \(BEC\), and \(CED\) are adjacent in that order. Their sum is
\[
85^\circ+60^\circ+35^\circ=180^\circ.
\]
Therefore \(A,E,D\) are collinear, with \(E\) between \(A\) and \(D\). It follows that
\[
\angle BAD=\angle BAE=\boxed{85^\circ},
\]
choice \(\text{C}\).
